company.shortDescription: Parker offers corporate credit cards to help e-commerce businesses pay expenses and manage their finances.
company.description: Parker offers corporate credit cards to help e-commerce businesses pay expenses and manage their finances. In order to increase profits and unleash the full potential of your brand, Parker offers its users a card to pay for expenses as well as tools to monitor important metrics. The company's eCommerce business credit card offers net terms on each transaction, has average credit limits higher than conventional business credit cards, and is targeted at middle-market businesses.

productsAndServices.description: A corporate credit card offering rolling credit terms up to 90 days and credit limits that scale with business performance, designed for e-commerce businesses to manage expenses and cash flow.
productsAndServices.name: Parker Card

productsAndServices.description: A high-yield business banking account offering up to 3.0% APY with FDIC insurance up to $5 million, integrated with Parker's financial ecosystem for flexible access and capital protection.
productsAndServices.name: Parker Treasury

productsAndServices.description: A payment service that allows businesses to use their Parker credit line to pay vendors, including those who do not accept cards, with flexible rolling payment terms up to 90 days.
productsAndServices.name: Parker Bill Pay

productsAndServices.description: A real-time financial analytics platform that consolidates e-commerce data to provide insights on profitability, cash flow forecasting, and customer lifetime value.
productsAndServices.name: Parker Intelligence
